# Futuruna

> Futuruna allows you or an AI to encode the rule of law into a rule model, and mix it with ordinary programming. You can then interview, audit, automate or explore the law like never before.

Futuruna 0.1.0 is MIT licensed. Futuruna can define types (#), functions (>), rules (|), streams (~), assignments (=), proofs (?), and effects (@). The Feature Stages document records the current maturity of each language and tooling surface.

Contact: research@futuruna.com

## Start Here

- [AI setup](https://futuruna.com/ai-setup.md): Set up Futuruna with an AI coding agent and begin a first project.
- [Documentation](https://futuruna.com/docs): Browse the Futuruna language reference.
- [First tutorial](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Futuruna/futuruna/main/docs/tutorial/01-hello.md): Build and run a first Futuruna program.
- [Playground](https://futuruna.com/playground): Try Futuruna in the browser.

## Language and Modeling

- [Reference index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Futuruna/futuruna/main/docs/reference/README.md): Route to the maintained language documentation.
- [Language basics](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Futuruna/futuruna/main/docs/reference/basics.md): Learn values, types, functions, rules, control flow, effects, and proofs.
- [The seven runes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Futuruna/futuruna/main/docs/reference/runes.md): Understand Futuruna's partitioned syntax.
- [Modeling style](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Futuruna/futuruna/main/docs/reference/style.md): Write readable formal-rule and ordinary-programming models.
- [Typed calculations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Futuruna/futuruna/main/docs/reference/calculations.md): Build typed rule models, templates, calls, and workbooks.
- [Feature Stages](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Futuruna/futuruna/main/docs/feature-stages.md): Check the current maturity of language and tooling features.
